title: Mixed Event — First Star After the Rain — Episode7 Ever Forward

meta.Event Outline: Saki has formed a band with her childhood friends and is enjoying what each day brings. She happens upon a poster for an observatory event one day and decides to plan a visit with her bandmates, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aha! It's you guys!
Which means you're here to check on Saki?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! I'll be in my room planning a new show, so don't mind me and go right upstairs to Saki's room.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I've just come up with an idea that'll make my show a huge success! I really am a genius!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And once it's ready for the stage, you're of course welcome to come see it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha... We'll make sure to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki's brother hasn't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, let's keep that to ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also need to thank you for walking Saki home yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're such great friends to her.
Thank you for always being there for her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a caring brother.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki's in her room. She was awake a little while ago, so I'm sure she'll be happy to talk to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, we're all here to visit you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki? Maybe she has nodded off?
Saki, it's us.
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...? She's not here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe she's in the bathroom.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Could be. Let's wait for her here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I need to use the bathroom too.
I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I always forget she has this cool ceiling with stars all over it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. They glow too, so it's probably even prettier when it's dark.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me... Didn't we all help her stick these stars to her ceiling? Tsukasa lent us a hand too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki's so short but she insisted on sticking some stars herself. It took so much longer because of that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well, this is strange.
Saki wasn't in the bathroom.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She hasn't gone downstairs based on what her brother said...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Does that mean...?
Could she have gone out?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't tell me she went to the observatory on her own...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But she wouldn't be able to see anything with this weather...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She really wanted to see the stars...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I know where she might have gone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Honami. Shiho.
Come with me!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My stay at the hospital wasn't easy, but there were some good moments.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The doctors and the other patients were very kind to me, and taught me how to juggle and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But sometimes I felt really lonely.
I'd look at the stars to feel better...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because it reminded you of the times when you saw them with your friends?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Where did Luka go...?
I've looked everywhere for her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is.
She's with...? Saki?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Saki looks so sad.
Maybe Luka is trying to cheer her up.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I should leave the two of them to talk.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Believing that I could stargaze with them again once I got better helped me get through some really awful medical tests.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But sometimes anxiety would suddenly overwhelm me sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How do I describe it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was scared that I was losing so much...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
Losing so much...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The time I have to be with my friends...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I kept thinking, we should be having classes together instead of this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Or that I should be having fun on that school trip with them, chatting and staying up late.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I should've been with them, but the clock was ticking away while I was in the hospital, unable to do anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt like it was all being taken away from me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt the same way even about the time I'd already spent with them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt... So scared...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I'm doing everything I can to make sure every moment matters.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I decided I won't let the time I should be spending with my friends slip away.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it only led to me pushing myself too hard, worrying everyone and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm... I'm such an really idiot...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You couldn't help but be anxious...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You wanted to get back what you lost.
That seems perfectly normal.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You felt that all those things couldn't wait.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you don't need to be in such a hurry to make up for that time. It's okay to take it easy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's what I sensed.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I think your friends would agree too.
Wouldn't you? Ichika, Honami, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat? When did you all get here?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We came to visit you, but you weren't in your room. Ichika correctly guessed you were here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you doing out of bed, you dummy?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-I'm so...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
For being so harsh towards you.
For saying some really mean things.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You getting sick and being cooped up in bed the other time was also my fault since I pressed you to do more than you could handle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I did it again, despite Luka warning me that you seemed a little out of it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm angry at myself for not being a better friend and noticing when something wasn't right. I even said some really mean things to you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You don't need to apologize!
It's all my own...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's not your fault, Saki. I didn't realize what was going on with you either. I would've figured it out if I'd only given it some thought.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Hona...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can take your time. We're going to spend lots of time together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's like what Luka said.
There's no need to hurry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're not going anywhere. We're always going to be together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone...!
